test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: reasoning
question: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line facing the north. C is between B and A. D is between B and H. E is third to the left of A. B is second to the right of A. G is between A and F. H is at one of the corners. Who is sitting at the other corner?
solution:
Given: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a straight line facing the north.

According to the given statements, we have,

1) C is between B and A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4840de34f4ec0897f579f72e17c1178e9b8d315c417d12cc01f57321badd027e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e787faf48ccc0f667f0e8c51560a3ff9fe4d117bd9e64c77acd7432dd41a5063.png] 

2) B is second to the right of A. Thus, case 1 is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ab0ed0f19c97a5cb4a35b2b587679fd1a10e70c61cd50d688f1de79255b8050.png] 

3) D is between B and H. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d66610eaa2e4c0522f65f7c82dc5f29372cb835d803124c21ff4f99f82d10687.png] 

4) G is between A and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c098d8ac0c4cecfbf55cb975300a5220c59be80e7548bfe805106b12ef96a121.png] 

5) E is third to the left of A. H is at one of the corners. Thus, the final arrangement will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0f5488bd93b5de76bed3b2b8db34825604fb3929de88b3697c6809aebb5af960.png] 

Hence, person __**E**__ is sitting at the other corner.
